title: Assignment 18 · Unconscionability
summary: Unconscionability. Assigned readings and principal cases for this class.
notes:
Williams v. Walker-Thomas Furniture Co.: The court recognized power to refuse an unconscionable bargain and remanded for findings; it did not itself finally decide that the customers’ contracts were unconscionable.

Stoll v. Xiong: A thirty-year right to valuable poultry litter, added to an already substantial land price and accepted without meaningful understanding, was an unconscionable provision.

Anderson v. Binance: The assigned 2026 opinion rejects Binance’s attempt to compel arbitration through later website terms, addressing both lack of constructive notice and the limits on retroactive modification.

Additional assigned materials: Restatement of Consumer Contracts § 6.
